brief.note: A quiet week so far; nothing new cleared 10% and the screen is down to two names.

candidates.name: Fluence Energy, Inc.
candidates.business: Builds grid-scale battery storage systems and sells optimisation software for renewables
candidates.cause: Cut full-year revenue guidance to about $2.4bn from $3bn and now expects a $200m adjusted EBITDA loss, blaming supply chain and Houston ramp problems.
candidates.right: The Houston ramp and supply chain must resolve before the cash burn forces a raise
candidates.wrong: Liquidity tightens as losses widen and the retreat from US business becomes permanent

candidates.name: J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc.
candidates.business: Trucking and intermodal freight carrier hauling containers across North America
candidates.cause: Warned mid-quarter that third-quarter profit will fall 5% to 10% from the second, on $25m more driver pay and higher fuel costs.
candidates.right: Freight rates must rise enough to pass on driver pay and fuel increases
candidates.wrong: A soft freight market leaves the cost inflation stuck on Hunt's own margins
